Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

naboer 0.1.0

New features

  • Added cross-validation folds with separate assessment and omission membership, validation, diagnostics, tibble views and plots. Designs export complete nei structures for mgcv NCV/QNCV, including optional neighbourhood sampling and covariance settings. Compatibility checks require at least two folds and explicit sampled fold numbers for nonsingleton omissions under the tested mgcv 1.9-4 integration.
  • Added spatial, temporal and spatiotemporal neighbourhoods and block designs, asymmetric elapsed/calendar/count windows, buffers and rolling-origin forecasts across multiple series and independent domains. Shared forecasting cutoffs exclude future observations across dependent series; calendar shifts preserve zero-width instants and use the index time zone.
  • Added grouped and hierarchical holdouts, environmental clustering and strata, phylogenetic distance neighbourhoods and clade/cluster holdouts, and faithful rsample import/export with preserved key/domain metadata and guarded analysis expansion. Imports require resamples indexing individual observations.
  • Added optional sf, tsibble and cubble adapters, indexed spatial queries, compressed interval storage, allocation guards and reproducible R benchmarks. Explicit spatial grid anchors remain stable across data subsets, and radius queries consistently use stored coordinates. The approximation study includes large-omission stress tests and independent weighted Gaussian refits.

User visible changes

  • The minimum supported R version is now 4.4.0.
